model.draw_algorithm: SHA256(seed:index:purpose), first uint32 big-endian / 2^32; independent completion, correctness and wrong-option draws. Fixed before assignment.
model.identity_algorithm: Run-bound server HMAC UUID derived from frozen model hash and session index; signed HttpOnly cookie remains stable across requests.
model.exposure_rule: Assigned explanation rendered; first factual sentence at least 50% visible in a visible document for 2000 cumulative milliseconds. Same rule in both arms.
model.wrong_answer: Uniform among the three non-key options; backend computes correctness from the submitted option.
model.reason: Deliberate illustrative 20 percentage point correctness contrast with equal high completion, useful for demonstrating recovery of a specified mechanism signal and a non-degrading guardrail. These probabilities are assumptions, not observed human behavior.
model.stopping_rule: Exactly 800 distinct indexed sessions. Resume failed infrastructure attempts at the same index/identity; never change probabilities/seed or replace a session to obtain a preferred result. Seal all new answers after the cohort completes.
model.analysis_rule: Inspect only after fixed cohort and transport reconciliation. Crossing-zero interval is INCONCLUSIVE, integrity failure DO_NOT_ACT. No claim of improved human comprehension.
